Git history has no poller.go either; the only poller-related commit (96d433d, INT-035-UNIT-168) touches worker/internal/rounds/rounds_test.go, a path that does not exist here. .ai-dlc/units stops at UNIT-010, so UNIT-218's acceptance criteria are not readable. units.title: Verify: Poll detection of SCHEDULED and CLOSED Rounds unit tests

tests.name: TestPollDetectsScheduledAndClosed
tests.title: Poll reports SCHEDULED and CLOSED Rounds without closing anything and pulls before listing
tests.scenario: Given R1 SCHEDULED, R2 OPEN ending one hour after the clock, and R3 CLOSED; When Poll runs; Then Scheduled is [R1], Closed is [R3], ClosedNow is empty, no error, closer is never called, and git calls are pull then list

tests.name: TestPollNoRounds
tests.title: Poll on a world with no Rounds returns empty results without error
tests.scenario: Given a fake Git with no Rounds; When Poll runs; Then no error is returned and Scheduled, Closed and ClosedNow are empty

tests.name: TestPollDetectsScheduledAndClosed
tests.title: Poll reports SCHEDULED and CLOSED Rounds, closes nothing, and pulls before listing
tests.scenario: Given R1 SCHEDULED, R2 OPEN ending one hour after the clock, and R3 CLOSED; When Poll runs; Then Scheduled is [R1], Closed is [R3], ClosedNow is empty, err is nil, closer.calls is empty, and git.calls is [pull, list]

tests.name: TestPollNoRounds
tests.title: Poll returns empty results when the world has no Rounds
tests.scenario: Given a fake Git with no Rounds; When Poll runs; Then err is nil and Scheduled, Closed and ClosedNow all have length 0

units.title: Verify: Expired Round closing unit tests with fake clock and Closer

tests.name: TestPollClosesExpiredOpenRound
tests.title: Poll closes every OPEN Round whose end time has been reached and leaves future Rounds open
tests.scenario: Given a fake clock at 12:00 UTC and a world with E1 OPEN ending at 11:00, E2 OPEN ending exactly at 12:00, and F1 OPEN ending at 13:00; When Poll runs; Then the Closer is called with E1 and E2 in order, ClosedNow and Closed are [E1, E2], err is nil, and F1 is not closed

tests.name: TestPollClosedAndNewlyClosedCombined
tests.title: Poll reports both already-CLOSED and newly closed Rounds in Closed, but only newly closed Rounds in ClosedNow
tests.scenario: Given a world with C1 already CLOSED and E1 OPEN and expired; When Poll runs; Then Closed is [C1, E1] and ClosedNow is [E1]

tests.name: TestPollClosesExpiredOpenRound
tests.title: Poll closes OPEN Rounds whose end time has been reached and leaves future ones open
tests.scenario: Given a clock at 12:00 UTC with E1 OPEN ending 11:00, E2 OPEN ending exactly 12:00 and F1 OPEN ending 13:00; When Poll runs; Then closer calls and ClosedNow and Closed are [E1, E2] with no error

tests.name: TestPollClosedAndNewlyClosedCombined
tests.title: Poll reports already-CLOSED Rounds in Closed and only newly closed Rounds in ClosedNow
tests.scenario: Given C1 already CLOSED and E1 OPEN and expired; When Poll runs; Then Closed is [C1, E1] and ClosedNow is [E1]

units.title: Verify: Poll error handling unit tests

tests.name: TestPollPullFailureAborts
tests.title: Poll aborts before closing anything when Pull or ListRounds fails
tests.scenario: Given a fake Git whose Pull or ListRounds fails with errBoom, When Poll runs, Then the error wraps errBoom, git calls stop at pull or list, and the Closer is never called.
tests.detail: Subtests pull_fails and list_fails both pass.

tests.name: TestPollCloseFailureContinues
tests.title: Poll keeps closing expired OPEN Rounds after one Close fails
tests.scenario: Given expired OPEN Rounds E1 and E2 where closing E1 fails with errBoom, When Poll runs, Then the error wraps errBoom, Close is attempted for E1 then E2, and only E2 appears in Closed and ClosedNow.

tests.name: TestPollNilCloser
tests.title: Poll returns an error instead of panicking when no Closer is configured
tests.scenario: Given a Poller built with a nil Closer and one expired OPEN Round, When Poll runs, Then no panic occurs and the error message contains "no closer configured".

tests.name: TestPollPullFailureAborts
tests.title: Poll aborts before closing any Round when pull or list fails
tests.scenario: Given a fake Git whose Pull or ListRounds fails with errBoom, When Poll runs, Then the error wraps errBoom, no Round is closed, and the result is empty.
tests.detail: Both subtests pass: pull fails (git.calls is [pull], closer untouched, Result empty) and list fails (closer untouched).

tests.name: TestPollCloseFailureContinues
tests.title: Poll keeps closing the remaining expired Rounds after one Close fails
tests.scenario: Given expired OPEN Rounds E1 and E2 where closing E1 fails with errBoom, When Poll runs, Then the error wraps errBoom, Close is attempted for E1 then E2, and Result.Closed and Result.ClosedNow are both [E2].

tests.name: TestPollNilCloser
tests.title: Poll returns an error instead of panicking when no Closer is configured
tests.scenario: Given a Poller built with a nil Closer and one expired OPEN Round, When Poll runs, Then no panic occurs and the error message contains "no closer configured".
tests.detail: poller_errors_test.go:123: Poll() panicked: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference, want error. Poll in poller.go has no nil-Closer guard before p.closer.Close; the Act agent must add one (return an error containing "no closer configured").
